content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm encountering issues with adding images, background colors, and other graphical elements in the [product_name] application. I've placed these files in both the 'img' and 'js/jqueryui/images' folders on the SD card, but nothing is showing up. The images are not visible in [product_name] while developing or when running the app for my chosen IP. Whenever I use the 'Image' feature and try to attach an image, the area is just blank. I've checked the [company_name] user forum for answers and consulted the [product_name] manual, but haven't found clear instructions about the correct folder for background images or graphics. Can anyone share how to resolve this issue?

Hello and welcome. Here in the forum, English is the common language, so please write your posts in English. I don't fully understand the problem yet. Are you referring to using custom images and graphics?

In the installation directory of [product_name], for example: 'C:\Program Files\[company_name]\[product_name]', there's a subfolder called '\res\Graph Library\My Graph'. I place my custom graphics there. To use one, drag the 'Image' element into your project and select the image from 'My Graph'. Save your project and transfer everything to the SD card. Leave the SD card in the device, and you can download the project to it directly from [product_name].

The issue is that when I try to add items through the application's 'Image' feature, the image area still remains blank. The same happens when I try to set background colors—they don't show up even after being applied.
I've seen similar problems temporarily when the horizontal position exceeds 999. Consider submitting a support request.

Even after adding the image, the spot stays blank. This also happens with the application's background colors. I've already opened a support ticket, but any other tips or solutions would be appreciated.
I'm facing the same issue, so if there's a solution, I'd like to hear about it too. Maybe I'm missing something?
I've tested with the default images; some appear, while others don't. Could it be related to the format or maybe the dimensions of the image box?

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users are experiencing issues with attaching and displaying images and background colors in the [product_name] application. Placeholders for these graphics often remain blank, both during development and on the actual device, even after files are placed correctly and features are used as intended. The documentation and forum discussions lack clear guidance on directory structure, indicating possible confusion about file management or limitations within the software regarding graphic support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily integrate and display custom images and background colors in their projects, following intuitive file placement and feature workflows as described in the documentation, ensuring visibility both during development and runtime.
